avis.texte: I've tried many different facial moisturizers with SPF and this is the only one that doesn't pill on my skin. I goes on smoothly and feels great. I wouldn't put it directly around the eyes (can sting) but otherwise great product for my dry, sensitive skin.

I bought this product on accident because the box it comes in looks exactly the same as the other AM moisturizer, but I figured I'd still give it a shot. I LOVED how light it felt when it went on and how quickly it absorbed into my skin, but after a couple of weeks I started to breakout like crazy. Turns out the first ingredient (avobenzone) isn't suitable for acne-prone, sensitive skin girlies like me. 😩 I wish I could've kept using it, but my skin hated it.
this is my "go to" sun screen and moisturizer bc there is no zinc oxide in it and I don't have to worry about white streaks! super smooth and long lasting :)

This sunscreen works perfect for me for my walks and for everyday use for protection, no scent, goes on clear and not heavy good size for my purse. Perfect when you want protection outside of your fun in the sun beach and swim days which for that I use other.

I have insanely oily skin. especially in the summer. this is not matte at all… even after applying and staying inside in the AC, I looked like a grease bucket. It doesnt seem to break me out too bad though, which is a plus. Maybe better for dead of winter?

I have comination skin that tends to get oily in the summer. This stuff is amazing. Non irritating, non greasy, gives the right amount of moisture with sun protection. Only downfall is the packaging. The pump sucks and its only 1oz of product. I need a jumbo size in a different bottle!!

avis.titre: I buy this product over and over
avis.texte: Love the light feel of this product. I need to wear sunscreen everyday and this works very well.
It's so light and does not get heavy or greasy at all! It's comparable to some Korean sunscreens to me and it doesn't disrupt glass skin!
This sunscreen burns my eyes so bad my eyes were watering. My eyes burned until the next day even after rinsing with water. Its so oily. This sunscreen also made my face red.

avis.titre: works well with my elfa poreless putty
avis.texte: I mix the elf poreles putty along with the cerave, and the loreal lumi drops. It doesnt pill and sticks nice to my skin. I finish it off with clinique blendable powder 08. gives me a nice finish all day.

avis.titre: This is my go to moisturizer
avis.texte: This is my go to moisturizer. It use it every day because it protects from sun damage and is not to greasy or heavy under my makeup!

I've been using this for years. I had stubborn adult acne due to BC, and this product, along with the rest of the Cerave line helped, and stuck with it ever since. I have very oily skin, so this product was never truly a mattiyfing moisturizer for me. I didn't know that the formula changed until others mentioned it, and i do notice the product feels lighter, like i have to use more product to feel like i have the amount of coverage i used to. I still like it, and i use other product to help with my oily skin like DM, this is just a great base.

Bought this sunscreen moisturizer after doing extensive research for a product that would not negatively affect my acne-prone, combo skin. Within two days, my pores were completely clogged. The day after I stopped using this product, I developed painful nodule acne on both sides of my face by my nose along with a large nodule on my chin. I also developed whiteheads on my chin and cheeks. Prior to starting this product, I was successfully recovering from a three year acne battle. I am hoping my skin recovers soon and that I eventually find an spf product I can use.

When they changed the packaging the formula changed with it. I had previously repurchased this product numerous times. I will never be buying it again. It leaves me completely greasy and oily and no longer has a matte finish. Super disappointing that I will now need to find a replacement in my routine for this product.

I like this product, the only downside is that the new packaging sucks! The pump is so short that more than half the product doesnt come out. I had to cut the product in order to be able to scoop out the remainder. I shouldnt have to do this, will have to look for another moisturizer.
worked initially, but now after a few hours. I'm oily. sighs. it's affordable. Will not repurchase
By far my favorite sunscreen! It goes on so smooth and easily with absolutely no white cast. I also like the packaging.
good for oily skin matte finish I'm not oily until the END of my day wish the bottle was bigger ! no white cast
It's light weight and extremely moisturizing with no residue left behind love it better than the the other ones

Been using this moisturizer for years, for everyday use and outdoor activities. The formula is not greasy and does not sting eyes when sweaty. My husband (super fair) also uses this and it provides great protection.

avis.titre: Has SPF, isn't oily and doesn't cake my makeup up!
avis.texte: I'm funny about my moisturizer. I want SPF of 30 or more, can't be oily, and doesn't need to make my makeup cake-up. IYKYK. This checks all the boxes and doesn't break the bank. I'm on my 4th tube and will continue to ADD TO CART!
After applying two layers before going into the sun I still got burnt. Didn't even seem like there was spf in it. My bliss tinted spf does the job. Unlike this.

This is my tried and true new favorite spf moisturizer!! I use this daily after my serum and before primer. Its so amazing, feels lightweight, doesn't cause pilling, leaves a natural (almost matte) finish, and is not greasy. I love love love this product for the price. I would say the pricey equivalent product that performs the same is Peter Thomas Roth water drench spf 45 hyaluronic cloud moisturizer - except this one is less than half the price!!! :D I am SO glad I tried this product, I found something I really love. Also scent free
I finally found the face sunscreen for me! had trouble with previous sunscreens, where they would leave a white cast, greasy or would sting my eyes. But this one does none of that! I love it!
I finally found the face sunscreen for me! had trouble with previous sunscreens, where they would leave a white cast, greasy or would sting my eyes. But this one does none of that! I love it!

avis.titre: Best moisturizer w/ sunscreen EVER for oily skin
avis.texte: This moisturizer has changed my skin. I wish I had started using it so much sooner. It isnt greasy, aborbs well, and dries matte. The. Best.

avis.titre: The best spf for my face I have come across
avis.texte: I've been using this product for years! Great and efficient! I have aging (36), sensitive, dry, acne prone skin. This is the only spf I have found that isn't greasy and quickly absorbs quickly. On me it isnt matte it gives me a beautiful glow which I actually need because my skin gets dry. It works beautifully under makeup too, which I love. I always get compliments on my skin so this is part of my daily morning routine. I highly recommend it.
Always make sure you buy products that wont clog your pores if you are acne-prone. This is a great way to start wearing spf
Works well on my problem skin. Great dispenser, very neat and efficient.

This is a great spf moisturizer that blends into the skin so beautifully. Non-greasy, doesn't pile (like the cerave AM!). I use two pumps for my face and neck. I use this every day under makeup. I wish they made this in a tinted version as well! Highly recommend. Safe for sensitive and acne prone! (I am very acne prone).

The ultra-light moisturizing lotion with SPF 30 is really nice. The only negative is the plastic cap becomes loose and cracks...every time. Please change this to a flip top or some other kind of cover that stays on. Thanks

For years I have been looking for a good spf and I finally found one! This feels so light yet so moisturizing! It absorbs super quick and stays well under my make up. It doesn't have any scent which I love. I just feel that for the price they should add more product but overall it's perfect
Love the product HATE the tube, repackage needed offer another option
Overall not a bad product. But it makes my eyes burn so bad & the burning lasts a while.

avis.titre: Clogged my pores after one use
avis.texte: Wow, this was really disappointing! I put it on once under makeup and I had so many clogged pores all over my face by the end of the day! Immediately stopped using and will go back to Supergoop. It also made my skin feel greasy about an hour later. Sadly, I've noticed a lot of Cerave products clog my skin and give me acne, which is the opposite of what they advertise. Not a fan.
My everyday SPF that leaves my skin looking glowy without looking greasy. Scentless and doesn't leave you smelling like sunscreen. Never gives me breakouts and has been a staple for years.
I use this everyday. It feels light on my skin. I do not even feel it under my makeup.
This is my favorite CeraVe product, its not heavy like most lotions, and the hyaluronic acid has helped with my acne and dryspots

The best 2 in 1 moisturizer and sunscreen. I've tried different sunscreens and moisturizer with sunscreen, bit I keep going back to this one. I just can't find any to replace this one. Has no white cast, melts easily into the skin, No Peeling! I keep repleneshing it. Just make it bigger and add niacinamide please! I don't like the Cerave AM moisturizer.

Love this moisturizer it's so light which is great for me because heavy thick moisturizer break me out and make me feel super greasy. I have tried both of theyre versions the normal on and the ultra light weight and this one by far has been the best working on my skin. I unfortunately ran out so need to get another one. The packaging is great it's slick and fits anywhere great for traveling.

avis.titre: Absolutely the BEST for oily skin
avis.texte: This is the best moisturizing/sun-screen I've ever used in 20 years of skincare history. I've got oily skin and the issue is that greasy sunblock means oilier skin. Moisturizers for oily skin usually leave a very odd-feeling layer. This truly is light weight and easy to apply through the day! Never using another product ever again!

avis.titre: Best sunscreen to protect your skin
avis.texte: You must always use sunscreens to protect your skin, you can use any product, then say that you can't find any results, with a good sunscreen, this one is the best I love 🥰

avis.titre: No white finish, good for under make up
avis.texte: So I didn't understand the importance of wearing sunscreen everyday until recently. I have since been shopping around for the perfect everyday sunscreen that still allows me to put makeup on top. This was the only light moisturizer sunscreen that didn't leave a white finish. It is light, brightening, and still allows me to achieve that glowing skin once I put on make up. 10/10 will forever buy this product. Wondering if they make it in a SPF 50 too for the hot Texas summers 😍

I love it! The Cerave Ultra-Light Moisturizing Gel has become a staple in my daily skincare routine. This water-based gel moisturizer is a delight to use. Its lightweight and refreshing texture make it a breeze to apply, and it absorbs quickly without any heaviness or greasiness. It's perfect for those who prefer a weightless feel on their skin.

Super light moisturizer, I love how it isn't super thick and stays on the face well. There is not a super strong sunscreen smell which is nice compared to other products with spf. The packaging is perfect, nozzle makes it easy to apply.

This is a good option for a daily spf if there are no others, but i find myself not using any spf if this is my only option. It's good for protecting, when i use it i notice my skins tone is even and that's great— i just don't like the way it makes my face feel. i'm looking for something light weight that doesn't make me feel sticky. My skin is also a little sensitive i feel like this breaks me out more than it should. Cerave products usually work amazing for me

avis.titre: Good for oily skin but question its sun protection
avis.texte: It doesn't leave an oily texture in the skin. However, I find it disappointing that it doesn't have zinc oxide in the ingredients. That's why, I can't trust this product itself for sun protection.
I'm very surprised on their quality compared with the price. I have the combination skin which is difficult to find the correct one but I'm very happy with this one.

avis.titre: My favorite moisturizer for the day
avis.texte: My go-to daily moisturizer! I have oily/combo skin and this is one of the few moisturizers I've found that doesn't make me more greasy. It almost feels like you have nothing on but my skin isn't dry and is protected from the sun. My only complaint is the formula is a little too liquid-y.

The perfect A.M. lightweight fragrance free drugstore moisturizer! This lasts all day and is a great affordable option although you will need to add sunscreen on top. I would totally recommend this for under makeup as well as regular wear!

I have combination skin and have a strictly powder makeup routine, so hopefully this helps if you're in the same situation! This sunscreen is to DIE for. Doesn't pill and gives the PERFECT glowy base to my makeup. Like holy hannah this is a must!

avis.titre: It's good but looks like i'm sweating
avis.texte: I read on an article that anything over 50 is ideal. The texture is really soft and absorbs well. it does make my face greasy. it doesn't smell. and the cap breaks easily

I love this product. I have very sensitive, oily skin, so I needed something lightweight with SPF and this works perfectly. My only gripe is with the packaging... every one of these that I have bought the clear plastic cap cracks then crumbles and will not stay on.
This has been my perfect daytime moisturizer. My dermatologist recommends CeraVe. It doesn't bead up when putting foundation on after

I love this as my everyday moisturizer. It's light weight and leaves my skin feeling so soft and hydrated. The fact that is has SPF is a bonus too for everyday use. It's not greasy at all and unscented. I've never had an issue with this breaking me out either. I've used higher end moisturizers that I don't like nearly as much - for the price point, this is great! I've never had an issue with white cast but I am fair skinned.

I love using this every day after using my Cerave foaming facial cleanser because it already has spf so you don't need to apply any more sunscreen on top. This is the perfect minimum amount for the winter, but you'll probably need extra spf for the summer. It's also very lightweight and perfect for oily skin.

avis.titre: Non direct contact with eyes BURNS BAD.
avis.texte: This product felt moisturizing at went on nicely. I put it on my whole face and was careful not to get too close to my eyes like any other moisturizer. While I was driving down the highway early on my way to work I rubbed my eyes and it started BURNING and I couldn't see anything cause of how much my eyes where watering and burning up, I had to pull over on the side of the highway to flush my eyes and use hand sanitizer to try to dry the product up off of my hands. Definitely not cool and should have a warning that it will burn if in contact with eyes like that. The regular moisturizer with no spf has NEVER done that and I am a horrible eye rubber especially within the hour or 2 of waking up

I have been wearing this sunscreen everyday for the last few years and get compliments on my skin all the time. I have combination to oily skin but this really balances me out and is simple skincare. My go-to!! I have tried many moisturizers with SPF trying to find one I liked. Compared to others, this one is so light and absorbs quickly. And oil free too!!!
My skin feel so smooth and soft after apply this sunscreen on my face love it

This is my #1 favorite sunscreen ever. I have oily sensitive skin and this just gives me such a subtle glow where it's just enough to make you look alive yk. I don't like where it's too much and looks like glitter so I love this and it doesn't burn my eyes!!! Repurchased over and over.
Fast absorbe, doesn't leave white cast even tho I have a tan skin , the only one thing I don't like is the scent , I wish it had less of the "sunscreen " scent .
Really great moisturizer/spf, sinks in beautifully and sits great under make up. Knocked one star because price at Ulta is waaayyy higher that other sites.

I love this moisturizer! I've been using this moisturizer since June of this year, and it has not disappointed. It absorbs super well into the skin. It does not have a greasy texture and has broad-spectrum SPF, 30 for sun protection.
I love this product but it does not have a matte finish. I have oily skin and with this my skin looks glowy and dewy rather than matte.

I've used this moisturizer for about three years. It's a really light moisturizer that doesn't irritate your eyes like other sunscreens/ moisturizers. It also doesn't have a strong fragrance. Couldn't recommend it enough!

Ultra light moisturizing gel CeraVe is my favorite brand as they takes good care of my skin . Their products works great for my dry skin . This ultra light moisturizing gel as the name indicates , it is really light and non greasy formula . It absorb quickly, you don't have to rub the gel unlike other moisturizers . It revive the skin and makes skin baby soft. I am using this gel as a primer and no doubt it is the best idea to skip my usual primer and use this gel . The added ingredients like ceramides, hyaluronic acid ,niacin-amide together working wonders for my skin. I love the packaging of this product, easy to dispense and use . It is fragrance free and is has sun protection ingredients too.. I am definitely going to recommend this super effective product to all my friends and family
This is the ONLY sunscreen I have found that doesn't leave a white cast or irritate my sensitive skin. Another great product from CeraVe

avis.titre: Great moisturizer for combo skin moisturizes but is light
avis.texte: Love love this moisturizer !!!I Actually buy is for both of my teens for their hormone filled combination skin but use it now and then because of how well it works on my middle aged changing skin. Recommend this one for the young and old, it is great!!!

I love this! This is all you need after washing your face in the morning to complete your skin protection and sun protection. It's not greasy at all, but it's nice to push it off your face. I use a lot of Cerave products, especially like the pump head design, it can keep clean and is very convenient.

This product is so amazing I absolutely recommend this for someone who enjoys going out in the sun and likes something g very light weight on your face. I would recommend this product. It's been effective for facial sun exposure needs, I will continue to buy.

First off I will say that this is an okay product I just don't think it's for me as I have extremely dry skin and I just felt like it didn't really do much as far as moisturizing goes with my skin. I also found that it made me break out a little. Not sure if that is due to my sensitive skin or just something in the product. I will say that I did like that the product did absorb into my skin quickly. It didn't leave me feeling sticky or oily or like I had product on my face. I also liked that there wasn't a scent to the product and it came in an easy to use pump. Overall it's not a bad product it's just not meant for my dry skin.

I recently started using the Ultra-Light Moisturizing Gel, and I'm genuinely impressed with its performance. The gel texture is incredibly lightweight, and it absorbs almost instantly upon application. It leaves my skin feeling refreshed and hydrated without any residue. It's perfect for those who prefer a non-greasy moisturizer. One thing worth noting is that it's generally fragrance-free, which is a big plus for those with sensitive skin or a preference for fragrance-free products . If you're looking for a versatile and effective moisturizer, especially for combination or oily skin, I highly recommend giving this product a try.

It revive the skin and makes skin baby soft. I am using this gel as a primer and no doubt it is the best idea to skip my usual primer and use this gel . The added ingredients like ceramides, hyaluronic acid ,niacin-amide together working wonders for my skin. I love the packaging of this product, easy to dispense and use . I am definitely going to recommend this super effective product to all my friends and family

avis.titre: A moisturizer fave for oily/acne prone skin
avis.texte: My favorite morning moisturizer. I love that it has SPF30 and mainly that it doesn't feel heavy on my skin. My skin is naturally oily so moisturizers usually can either make it worse or even clog my pores/make me breakout. However, I've used this moisturizer for years and have loved it. This little tube also lasts surprisingly a long time as well. So bonus!
This is my go-to facial spf. I use it everyday rain or shine! My derm recommended it to me and I have been using it ever since. It's a light formula, not greasy, and doesn't leave a cast!
Terrible package. Unless you store it cap side up, you squirt nothing until it spurts out at once. I'll never buy it again. Give me a screw on cap!

I have never, ever had a moisturizer that could work so well in my oily skin. Only con is the dispenser. This kind of dispenser, I know the tube will still have product in it, but I will not able to get the last of it out. I will have to buy a new tube. Such a waste of great stuff

avis.titre: Lightweight, non-greasy lotion with great SPF coverage.
avis.texte: This lotion is lightweight, is not greasy, and does not leave a white film. Goes on smoothly and provides great SPF coverage. I use it every day and am on my second bottle. The pump allows you to not waste or use excess product. Price is not too expensive and is worth it for a great product that is gentle on your skin. Awesome size for travel as well. ☀️😌
Product caused a rash on my face, ears and on my neck. Is this normal, will this go away or should I just discontinue product

I have a really hard time with skincare products especially spf because I have extremely dry and sensitive skin. This is the only product I used with spf that I can use everyday without any issues. It's never broken me out. Its my holy grail product and i have been using it for years! Goes very well under makeup and gives my skin a glow! Love this and highly recommend!

avis.titre: LOVE but please change the cap :/
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product and buy it repeatedly, but my only complaint is that the cap to the bottle cracks very quickly and becomes unusable.. this is super inconvenient and makes traveling with the product incredibly annoying. Cerave please change this!!!

Great product!! Horrible packaging. Please please please replace the plastic lid and/or totally repackage this product to match your others. Love this cream, but the lid is worthless making it impossible to store and travel with.

avis.titre: Not my favorite but good for acne prone skin
avis.texte: Doesn't work the best under make up, but it is a good moisturizer for after taking off your make up, and just needing something to keep your face, feeling refreshed!

i really like this product and enjoy how it doesn't pill or leave a white cast. It feels very light and is matte after applying it. i have oily skin so after a few hours i do get oily but i usually wipe it off after. i would definitely get this product again if it was a higher spf.
Perfect for my sensitive skin. No allergy problems like I have with so many other products. Cream is light and is perfect for every day especially with no make up.
I just recently purchased this sunscreen and then purchased a second one so I wouldn't run out too soon. It go on the skin so well and feels so hydrating and doesn't irritate the eyes what so ever.

avis.titre: SPF!! Feels nice for the day
avis.texte: I love that it's light and that it has spf. The price is decent and you don't have to use too much to get full coverage. The only downfall is that at the end of the day, you can feel it on your face, at least in my opinion. So make sure you wash your face at the end of the day :) you should anyway, but especially if you have any product on it- like this one. Will purchase again!

I love this lotion. I like how light weight it is while still hydration my face. It blends beautifully into the skin. Overall an amazing lotion the spf helps with sun protection. I will be purchasing again!!!

My favorite sunscreen!! Doesn't leave a white cast and isn't sticky once it's applied. The only thing that is annoying is the cap breaks really easily. Towards the end of the tube, the clear cap starts to crack and won't stay on anymore. Please fix this!

This is a good product. It was my favorite sunscreen for so long but I found one that I enjoy more. In the summer it can feel a little bit oily. I won't be buying it again just because they increase the price and there are better options for the price

Finally a sunscreen that doesnt pill under my makeup. I have tried so many and they pill or make ny skin look very dry under rhe makeup. I have combo oily skin and this is light but moisturizing enough to be under makeup. I even apply two layers and let it sink in 5-10 min before my makeup.

I love this product, it's my favorite facial moisturizer / sunscreen I've ever used. Perfectly lightweight but still adequately hydrating. My only qualm is the packaging - the clear plastic lid shatters and essentially disintegrates after about a week. Without the lid, the tube cannot sit upright. I think CeraVe could make the product better by having different packaging

This is the holy grail for combination skin. It is moisturizing enough for my dry areas, but doesn't make me greasy in my T zone. I recommend this to all of my friends for a great moisturizer with SPF!
It feels great on my oily skin! Love that it is moisterizer/sunscreen + ceramides! Super light weight and NO white Cast!

The formula is non-greasy, absorbs quickly and is water resistant, which makes it perfect for outdoor activities. One of the best features of this sunscreen is that it leaves no white residue or greasy feeling on the skin. In fact, it leaves the skin looking and feeling hydrated and soft. This sunscreen is perfect for all skin types, including sensitive skin. So, if you want a sunscreen that not only protects your skin, but also keeps it looking and feeling as good as possible.

I would always gloss over this sunscreen because I tried the other Cerave AM Facial lotion, which I did not like. However, this one is very different and I really enjoy it. If you have oily acne prone skin I highly recommend checking this out. It wears beautifully under makeup or by itself as a daily sunscreen. Works well at keeping my skin matte all day. However, with most chemical sun, it does not do well around my eyes. For the price, it's really worth trying out.

avis.titre: Surprised By How Much I Love This!
avis.texte: I received a sample of this as part of a "gift with purchase" recently and wasn't sure what to expect as CeraVe's products have been hit or miss with me in the past. I also have sensitive combination skin so wasn't sure if a sunscreen made for normal/oily skin would be suitable. I gave it a try and was actually somewhat blown away because sunscreen always feels gross on my face, but this barely felt like sunscreen… in a good way. I'd call the consistency a milky moisturizer. Despite being ultra-light it's actually quite hydrating for my skin. And it didn't cause redness as many chemical sunscreens do. The only thing I wish is that it had a higher spf, but I understand the limitations. I can definitely see myself purchasing the full size!
Excellent light weight moisturizer with SPF 30. It left my skin feeling soft and hydrated.

My go to moisturizer. I've used it for a couple years. It doesn't break me out or have a cast, it absorbs quickly and feels non greasy, and in goes well under face sunscreen. I'm about 10 minutes its fully absorbed and I wear make up over it.
It's very light when applied on￼, goes on very smoothly. I especially love that it doesn't have a weird sunblock smell￼.

Literally the best moisturizer with SPF. No one talks about this! The formula is amazing, no white cast and has a skin like finish, it's not fully matte which I love and it's not super glowy which can make you look super shiny. Perfect middle!

I absolutely love the Cera Ve Ultra Light moisturizer and SPF! It is super light weight, radiant, and hydrating! It kept my skin moisturized and glowing for hours. I prefer to apply it both mornings and afternoons to keep my skin extra moisturized since I am on the dryer skin type side of the spectrum. I also love how this product was easy to rub in and didn't dry out throughout the day like other SPFs and moisturizers I have tried. It didn't cause any breakouts or irritation for me, and that says a lot because I have very sensitive skin! Can we also take a moment to admire the bottle and how nicely it pumps out the product? I would call this a "Cera Ve slay!" 10/10 product.

Yes! If you have oily skin or don't like the heavy feeling of most moisturizers, this is it! It's such an excellent price and it's a moisturizer, sunscreen, and makeup primer in one. The matte finish is gorgeous. Definitely a holy grail.

I have finally found something that I love in terms of sunscreen. This is light and moisturizing enough for normal to oily skin. Does have a matte finish as it states and no scent. Not even that overwhelming sunscreen scent. This is bearable and I just love it. I had not trouble wearing this everyday. Just feels like a light moisturizer. Great under makeup. No pilling. Just so convenient. A KEEPER for me!
I love this moisturizer! It's affordable and works well. I use it every night and have been for about a year now. I have repurchased it once already and plan to again once my current one runs out.

I have sensitive skin that's slightly dehydrated. I was hesitant to use this since it's geared towards normal-oily skin types. However, this is the most cosmetically elegant sunscreen I have ever used. After washing my face, I use a vitamin C serum and apply this lotion. I usually wait 15-20 minutes before priming my skin for makeup. There's no pilling, separation, or irritation. As a bonus, my makeup looks amazing. I highly recommend this product.
Love this product so much I love how it gives my skin, a glow and I love how the product comes and I really recommend this product because it has clean my face and I have seen some results in my face
It blends well enough and quickly sinks into the skin. If you have dry skin or prefer dewy looks you may want a moisturizer or hydrating primer if you use makeup. Overall pretty nice
This product is very good, so good that sometimes it is difficult for me to find it in stores, however, I despair when it is almost finished. excellent moisturizer and sunscreen for the face

I love this lotion. The pump is very convenient and makes this product even better. If you have trouble getting the product out shake the bottle and it will work again. I have dry skin and keep coming back to this SPF because it's hydrating and the consistency is creamy in a way that doesn't dry out my skin. I find that foundation looks beautiful on top of this. Does not look matte as it claims to on my dry skin either. I love it. Plsss don't change the formula or discontinue!!! I would like to see another version of this in SPF 50. I will definitely continue repurchasing no matter what. I have recommended this many times.

I was using the Am moisturizer for normal to dry skin but because my skin is oily I would look super shiny afterwards. I switched to this product with is for normal to oily skin. What a difference! This product is lightweight, dries with a soft matte finish and has SPF. It's a win for me.

avis.titre: The only SPF so far that doesn't burn my eyes
avis.texte: I can't figure out why this one is so special but it is so it will definitely be a repurchase. Feels great on my oily skin and doens't leave a white cast.

avis.titre: Very Lightweight, Feels Great on Skin
avis.texte: Love this sunscreen! I am a fan of most CeraVe products and this is no exception. Is very lightweight and leaves my skin feeling hydrated and smooth. I am prone to acne but this doesn't seem to be causing any breakouts, which is great. :)
This is my favorite morning moisturizer. It's nice and lightweight and doesn't have any cast from the spf. Definitely recommend
This product is ultra light, non-irritating and sunscreen in product does not leave white or metallic cast on skin. I love everything CeraVe makes. Fantastic sensitive skin products.

Will continue to use and update but at the moment I like this product. It is for normal to oily skin and dries down with a matte finish. Looks and feels nice on my skin. Has good ingredients and of course sunscreen.
My favorite drugstore spf moisturizer of them all. The longevity performs well on my face and I love the glow

I highly recommend this product to anyone who has combination to oily skin. It is very lightweight, as the name suggests. It doesn't make your skin more oily and has an effect of making your skin sort of matte but still have that natural glow or shine - but not in an oily way. It is very moisturizing as well and convenient because of it being both a moisturizer and sunscreen. However, the only reason I didn't give it 5 stars was because of the small size of the tube/bottle. Since it is recommended to apply sunscreen daily, every few hours, one may have repurchase this more frequently than other similar products that are offered in bigger sizes. I wish it came in a bigger tube. Overall, it is a very great product!

avis.titre: Best product for my sensitive skin
avis.texte: This is the only thing I can use on my sensitive skin to keep it from being. Dry and flaky and not turn my skin red! In the colder weather my skin becomes dry and this product helps to keep it moisturized without adding too much build up! Definitely worth it!
